summary.name: ReadPo
summary.one_liner: ReadPo is an AI-powered reading and writing assistant that collects content from sources like Google News, RSS and X (Twitter), then helps turn it into articles and posters.
use_cases: Writing newsletters or blog posts from multiple news sources
Catching up on a topic by summarizing many articles
Filtering Google News by keyword for a digest
Creating info cards and posters with text
Monitoring RSS feeds or X accounts for writing material
summary.what_it_does: The page describes ReadPo as an end-to-end flow: collect content from topic sources (Google News filtered by keyword, any RSS feed, or any Twitter user), filter and read it, then summarize and write. It says its AI uses retrieval (RAG) to reference real-time external information rather than writing from the model alone. Output includes articles and poster images, with 24 poster templates on the free plan. Usage is measured in credits, where reading a batch costs 1 credit, AI scoring 1 credit, and AI writing 2 credits.
notable: Topic-based reading that gathers multiple sources on one subject for comparison before writing
Uses retrieval (RAG) over live sources rather than pure LLM generation
Credit-based usage with a free tier and paid Starter and Pro plans
caveats: Pro-tier and Starter prices shown are early-bird discounts (50% off), which are limited-time
Several features are marked coming soon, including API access, agent mode, and saving any webpage as a source
Free plan is limited to 2 topics and 30 credits per month
